response.sql: WITH archstat_projects AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), summary_stats AS (SELECT archstat, tally, SUM(tally) OVER () as total_tally, COUNT(*) OVER () as num_statuses FROM archstat_projects) SELECT archstat, tally, CAST(tally as REAL) / total_tally as share, (CAST(tally as REAL) / total_tally) - (1.0 / num_statuses) as above_average FROM summary_stats WHERE (CAST(tally as REAL) / total_tally) > (1.0 / num_statuses) ORDER BY share DESC
